offering_description.value: Delivers electricity, natural gas and steam through regulated networks to homes and businesses in New York City and Westchester County, with rates set by state regulators. Customers are billed for metered energy use, and the company maintains and upgrades its networks.

primary_services.value: electric and gas distribution; steam distribution; emergency response; network maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential homes and apartment residents; B2B: commercial and industrial customers, building owners, real estate developers; B2G: city and state government agencies, public institutions

end_markets.value: real estate; commercial offices; manufacturing; public sector; residential housing

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: metered charges for electricity, gas and steam delivered to customers; service fees: connection, meter and other utility service charges
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs energy networks, takes in power and gas supplied by generators and pipelines, sells delivered energy to local customers

geography_served.value: US regional: New York City and Westchester County, New York

specialization.value: related lines: electricity, natural gas and steam delivery sharing networks, customers and billing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility bills and service agreements sent directly to customers; online: online account management and bill payment for customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: high: utility rates and operations regulated by New York State Public Service Commission and federal energy regulators

offering_description.value: Develops, owns and operates renewable energy projects such as solar and battery storage, selling power and energy services under long-term contracts to commercial, industrial and government customers across several US states.

primary_products.value: solar power; battery storage; renewable energy certificates

primary_services.value: project development; operations and maintenance; energy management

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial and industrial power buyers, utilities, project investors; B2G: government agencies buying renewable power

end_markets.value: power generation; commercial real estate; utilities; public sector

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: payments for electricity generated and delivered under power purchase contracts; project or contract: development and construction fees for energy projects
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs solar and storage assets, sells power output to offtakers; service provider: operates and maintains projects for third-party owners and customers

geography_served.value: US national: projects in multiple US states, including New York and other Northeast and Southern states

specialization.value: related lines: solar generation, battery storage and related energy services sharing customers and project development

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: long-term contracts negotiated directly with commercial, industrial and government buyers; partners / resellers: joint ventures and partners that co-develop projects

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: medium: renewable energy incentives, power market rules and environmental permitting under federal and state agencies
